evidence_quote: Utprerana: ताप्लेजुङको फक्ताङलुङ गाउँपालिका—६ रामधाङ क्षेत्रबाट देखिएको नेपाल पिक (हिमाल)को दृश्य (Nepal Peak, seen from Taplejung). Shikshasanjal: नेपाल पिक पर्ने जिल्ला : ताप्लेजुङ (the district containing Nepal Peak is Taplejung). English Wikipedia confirms the 7,177 m Nepal-India border summit but gives no Nepali name.
notes: Confirmed as recommended: नेपाल पिक, with नेपाल पिक हिमाल as the fuller media variant.

evidence_quote: Nepali Wikipedia, गणेश हिमाल, photo caption: चुचुराहरू (बायाँदेखि दायाँ): नाम नभएको चुचुरो (६२५० मि), गणेश-II, पविल, सालसुङ्गो (peaks left to right: unnamed 6,250 m, Ganesh-II, Pabil, Salasungo).
notes: Confirmed as recommended: amended label गणेश-II, with Ganesh NW as the English alias.

evidence_quote: English Wikipedia: Thulagi Chuli (or Thulagi Peak) is a mountain in Mansiri Himal, a high subrange of the Himalayas in north-central Nepal. No Nepali form is given. The infobox lists District Gorkha, while the master assigns Manang (402).
notes: Kept pending as recommended: no Nepali attestation; transliteration acceptable only if the reviewer accepts it.

evidence_quote: English Wikipedia carries the Nepali name रत्नचुली in the article. Nepali Wikipedia (बुढानीलकण्ठ स्कूल) lists रत्नचुली among visible peaks. Peregrine Treks uses both रत्न चुली and रत्नचुली: रत्न चुली अभियान ... ७,१२८ मिटर ... रत्नचुलीको नजिक पुग्छ.
notes: Confirmed as recommended: closed form रत्नचुली, with रत्न चुली as an alias.
